title: Surfacing Disagreement Beats Resolving It: A Gated Ablation Study of Provenance-Weighted Memory for Multi-Agent Debate
abstract: arXiv:2611.22461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shared memory for multi-agent debate is usually built to resolve inconsistency: retrieval returns one winning fact and the disagreement disappears before any agent sees it. We ask whether that is correct. In DebateGraph, four backends share one contract (read/write/snapshot), so five mechanisms from the agent-memory literature can be removed independently under a fixed budget, each gated on a pre-declared threshold. Across 39 runs one survives: preserving contradictions and passing the ranked conflict set to the debate, rather than collapsing it to a winner, improves F1 by +0.340 (95% CI [+0.267, +0.414]) and cuts attack success from 22 to 7 of 122 poisoned items (McNemar exact p=0.0003), at equal cost. Reaching it meant fixing a bottleneck in our harness: conflict sets are built only over retrieved edges, and our pre-declared cap left three quarters of planted contradictions unretrievable, first measuring the mechanism at +0.084. translated_title: 呈现分歧胜过解决分歧：多智能体辩论中溯源加权记忆的门控消融研究
translated_abstract: 多智能体辩论的共享记忆通常被设计用来解决不一致性：检索返回一个“获胜”的事实，分歧在任何智能体看到之前就已消失。我们质疑这种做法是否正确。在DebateGraph中，四个后端共享一套统一契约（读/写/快照），因此来自智能体记忆文献的五种机制可以在固定预算下被独立移除，每个机制都以预先声明的阈值进行门控。在39次运行中，只有一种机制幸存：保留矛盾并将排序后的冲突集传递给辩论，而不是将其坍缩为单一获胜者，可将F1提升+0.340（95%置信区间 [+0.267, +0.414]），并将122个中毒项中的攻击成功数从22降至7（McNemar精确检验 p=0.0003），且成本不变。要得出这一结果，需要修复测试框架中的一个瓶颈：冲突集仅基于检索到的边构建，而我们预先声明的上限导致四分之三的植入矛盾无法被检索，最初测得该机制的效果仅为+0.084。
tldr: 多智能体辩论的共享记忆应保留矛盾并将排序后的冲突集呈现给辩论各方，而非将其坍缩为单一获胜事实——这一做法在同等成本下将F1提升0.340，并把投毒攻击成功率从22/122降至7/122。
en_tdlr: For multi-agent debate memory, surfacing ranked contradiction sets to debaters beats collapsing conflicts into a single winning fact—improving F1 by +0.340 and cutting poisoning attack success from 22 to 7 of 122 items at equal cost.
